# Water

Metered supply with Wolds Water since the house was bought in March 2024.

## Account

- Account number: WW-70041882
- Meter location: front boundary, under the plastic cover by the gate
- Estimated annual charge: 412.00, billed half-yearly

## Notes

The meter reading is submitted online twice a year. A reading that skips a cycle
produces an estimated bill that has always been high and has always been
corrected on the next actual reading.
